newsitem.title: ITALY: BNL said pondering full BancoNapoli merger.
newsitem.headline: BNL said pondering full BancoNapoli merger.

text.p: Banca Nazionale del Lavoro, which is preparing a joint bid for Banco di Napoli with insurer INA, is pondering a full-scale merger with the struggling southern bank, an Italian newspaper said on Wednesday.
Milan daily Il Sole 24 Ore said that BNL saw the joint bid as a first step towards creating a merged entity "in the medium to long term" with INA as part of a hard core of shareholders.
INA said on Tuesday that an INA board meeting had authorised its executives to prepare an offer to buy a 60 percent stake in Banco di Napoli together with BNL.
The Italian treasury has given interested parties until December 20 to make offers.
The treasury took temporary control of Banco di Napoli after it unveiled record losses of 3.12 trillion lire in 1995 and plunged a further 674 billion into the red in the first half of this year.
